comment: Labels the factory relies on. Created on merge by .github/workflows/labels-sync.yml, or by hand with `node scripts/seed-backlog/seed.js labels` (both create missing ones, never edit); the controller warns at startup if any is missing. A label that doesn't exist can't be applied by a person (e.g. factory:revert-reviewed, needed for D7's revert).

labels.name: factory:task
labels.description: A factory task issue (one contract)

labels.name: factory:ready
labels.description: Ready to dispatch

labels.name: factory:picked
labels.description: Dispatched; in flight

labels.name: needs-human
labels.description: Handed to a person; the controller won't act on it

labels.name: blocked
labels.description: Can't be dispatched (bad marker, contract or duplicate)

labels.name: stale-contract
labels.description: The contract changed after dispatch

labels.name: factory:alert
labels.description: A person must review (spend-bound alert)

labels.name: factory:infra-incident
labels.description: A factory defect broke this task's attempts (see the Infra incident comment)

labels.name: factory:revert-reviewed
labels.description: A person reviewed the controller's auto-revert PR

labels.name: tier:auto
labels.description: Contract tier: auto

labels.name: tier:auto-strict
labels.description: Contract tier: auto-strict

labels.name: tier:human
labels.description: Contract tier: human

labels.name: factory:bug
labels.description: Port bug report for the intake (monitor, or a person with write access)

labels.name: monitor
labels.description: Filed by the nightly monitor

labels.name: drill
labels.description: A fire drill; nothing is really wrong

labels.name: intake:proposed
labels.description: The intake confirmed a port bug and proposed a fix task PR

labels.name: intake:not-a-port-bug
labels.description: chrono-node gives the same result: the port is faithful

labels.name: intake:not-ported-yet
labels.description: Needs steps the port doesn't have yet

labels.name: upstream
labels.description: A new chrono-node release (upstream sync)

labels.name: upstream:bump
labels.description: Draft the human-tier bump PR for this upstream release

labels.name: dependency-request
labels.description: A crate request for the dependency steward

labels.name: dependency:borderline
labels.description: Hard checks passed, soft checks didn't: the owner decides within 24 h

labels.name: dependency:approved
labels.description: The owner accepts a borderline dependency request

labels.name: dependency:rejected
labels.description: The dependency steward rejected the request

labels.name: dependency:pr-open
labels.description: The dependency steward opened the PR

labels.name: factory-review
labels.description: The factory review (Loop 4) report: proposals for the owner

labels.name: factory-v2
labels.description: Factory v2: one language's port (docs/factory-v2.md)

labels.name: factory-v2:ready
labels.description: Factory v2: start (or restart) this language's port
